research_question: Which parts of the current trend-regime measurement are invariant across carrier, bar interval, and phase, and which parts require governed profile-specific calibration?

evidence_levels.engineering_computable: profile exists in versioned registry and causal grid checks are defined
evidence_levels.historical_research_available: an exact-view historical source with auditable identity exists for a predeclared research window
evidence_levels.runtime_admitted: stable consumer has an exact source admission receipt and may return the profile

stages.goal: inventory exact historical views, source roles, date coverage and governance restrictions without reading market outcomes
test whether raw slope_t and V1 T1=2 state occupancy are stable across carrier/interval/phase before any calibration
metrics: DOWN SIDEWAYS UP occupancy under fixed T1=2

stages.goal: test whether the same nominal state has comparable temporal meaning across profiles
metrics: directional-family survival at predeclared bar horizons
opposite-direction entry probability at predeclared bar horizons

stages.goal: select the narrowest calibration family supported by X2/X3 evidence
stages.rule: prefer the simplest family that preserves comparable state occupancy and state-dynamics meaning across admitted research profiles; do not optimize for trading return

stages.goal: repeat the frozen invariance protocol on additional structurally different broad/style indices before claiming generality
stages.minimum_target: at least 5 materially distinct index families if exact-view sources are available

stages.goal: decide whether evidence justifies keeping V1 unchanged, a backward-compatible metadata/minor extension, or a new major representation

predeclared_diagnostics.role: diagnostic only until X4; V1 lookback remains 20
predeclared_diagnostics.role_t1: diagnostic grid for stability analysis; not a product threshold selection by outcome maximization

decision_principles: Do not assume slope_t standardization automatically creates cross-profile semantic invariance.
Do not use a single carrier or a single phase to establish universal thresholds.
Do not pool profiles to hide material phase heterogeneity.
Do not tune thresholds on future trading returns.
If a universal numeric threshold fails, retain a unified method/semantic layer and allow governed profile calibration rather than forcing false universality.
Any calibrated profile must retain explicit profile/version identity.
forbidden_claims_before_completion: T1=2 is universal across all intervals
20 bars is universal across all intervals
strength is directly comparable across all profiles
all M3 profiles are empirically certified
legacy development views are runtime admitted
cross-profile invariance implies BUY SELL position order routing or strategy selection
next_action: execute X1 source/profile inventory and freeze eligible research windows before reading profile outcome statistics
